concerns.text: T009 (Ingestion skeleton) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) and placed in Phase 2, but its description explicitly requires 'hardcoded' ILRS URLs as a pre-requisite. T014 (Implementation of fetch_single_satellite) depends on these URLs being resolved/verified. If T009 runs before the URLs are verified (per Constitution Principle II), it will either fail or embed unverified data. T009 must depend on the verification step (or be split), and cannot be parallel-safe relative to the data-source validation gate.

T021 and T022 are marked [P] (parallel-safe) and listed as 'TDD-first' tests for the estimator. However, T021 explicitly 'depends on interface definition in T024'. T024 (Implementation of estimator) is a consumer of the interface definition. You cannot run the tests (T021/T022) in parallel with the implementation (T024) if the tests require the interface to be defined first. The 'TDD-first' note implies T021/T022 should precede T024, but the [P] tag suggests they can run concurrently with T024, creating a logical contradiction in the execution order.

T025 extracts 'ac' and 'g' from the joint solution. T026 computes 'eta = |ac| / g'. The description of T026 implies it performs the calculation 'from the joint covariance matrix' independently, but logically it must consume the 'ac' and 'g' values produced by T025. If T026 is marked as independent or parallel to T025, it will fail to find the required inputs. T026 must strictly follow T025 in the dependency chain.

T014.1 (fetch_all_satellites) orchestrates the loop over satellites and calls T014 (fetch_single_satellite). T014.1 is listed after T014, which is correct, but T014.1 is not marked as dependent on T014 in the [P] logic. If T014.1 is attempted before T014 is implemented, it will fail. While the list order is correct, the lack of explicit dependency notation (or [P] exclusion) for T014.1 relative to T014 creates a risk of parallel execution failure if a team member attempts T014.1 before T014 is complete.

T009 description contains a syntax error: 'hardcoded as pre-requisites in this task (e.g., ) to satisfy...'. The URL placeholder is empty. This breaks the semantic flow of the task description and makes the 'hardcoded' requirement ambiguous.
